prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer.
Asset: one transparent player avatar in an established cozy Ukrainian board-game painted cat character series.
Input images: Image 1 is the ONLY human identity, hair, facial hair, expression, pose and clothing reference, Ihor Novoseltsev. Image 2 supplies ONLY the established gouache/colored-pencil medium, proper feline anatomy, contained bust framing and finish. Do not copy image 2's full dark beard, frontal serious expression, haircut or collared shirt.
Primary request: reimagine the man in image 1 as a recognizable anthropomorphic CAT. Preserve his short dark brown hair, very closely faded sides and short gently brushed top, high broad forehead with slightly receding temples, oval slightly angular face and defined jaw, straight softly arched brows, hazel/gray-green eyes and their original spacing, friendly small open smile showing a little upper teeth, trimmed thin brown moustache and short light jaw/chin beard stubble. Translate facial hair into subtly darker short fur, NOT a large full bushy beard. Keep his source-photo natural adult proportions and cheerful relaxed expression. Give him a REAL short feline muzzle, small natural cat nose and delicate whiskers; warm muted brown/taupe fur with soft cream muzzle and cheek highlights.
Anatomy: EXACTLY TWO pointed CAT ears TOTAL, on TOP of the head and fully contained with clear margin. The sides of the head at eye level are uninterrupted short fur/hair: NO human ears, extra lower ears, fleshy lobes or side-ear folds.
Clothing: fully clothed plain black outdoor hooded zip-up jacket, zipped high up the neck, hood gathered behind the neck, visible front zipper and slightly crisp windbreaker texture. Remove large sleeve lettering and all logos. No collared shirt. Omit the hand gesture and extended selfie arm for consistent bust framing.
Style: detailed warm hand-painted gouache and colored pencil, softly dimensional brush-textured fur and clothing, imperfect warm brown contours and ivory highlights, matching the existing portrait series.
Composition: square canvas, one single contained head-and-upper-torso bust, subtle three-quarter selfie angle matching image 1 with face looking toward the viewer and relaxed smile, naturally rounded lower shoulder silhouette, generous transparent margins around head, ears and shoulders. No hands or lower body.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha. Remove sunlight glare, outdoor road, fence, house, plants and every background object. No other people, props, frame, badge, circle, text or watermark.
